errors.text_span: подредени в азбучен ред по кодовете на страните
errors.evidence: The description states that the countries on the x-axis are sorted alphabetically by their codes. However, the sequence (LV, RO, HU, BG, etc.) is not alphabetical. The bars are sorted in ascending order of their total height (total energy cost).

The legend indicates that the blue component of the bars is "Електроенергия" (Electricity). The description incorrectly maps the blue color ("син") to "Енергия за отопление" (Energy for heating), which is a text label in the legend without an associated color swatch.

The legend entry for the blue-colored component is "Електроенергия" (Electricity). The description incorrectly assigns this category to the color "тъмносин" (dark blue), which is both an inaccurate color description and contradicts the previous incorrect mapping of the blue color.
The description states that the energy cost in Denmark (DK) reaches about 2,700 €, but the top of the bar for DK aligns with approximately 2,600 € on the left y-axis.
